description: The top-ranked task cards within the available pilot helpers (python-object, serial, scpi, gymnasium, mujoco), an equal share per bucket, for MHS/handoff/pilot-20.json (WP-11). Exemplars (wave 0) are listed in their bucket and are not pilot repos; every other candidate is wave 1. Within a bucket strict-ready cards come first, then the rank score; a bucket served by two helpers takes its cards from the two families in turn.
rank_formula: rank_score = 40*partner + 20*hardware_mode + 10*helper_available + 8*has_tests + 5*log10(stars+1) - 15*gpu - 20*license_unknown; sorted by descending score, ties by package_id
